inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead electric utility pole
inputs.question: On Sheet 21 (Electrical Plan), identify the location of utility poles on the OHE line. Are there tree symbols visible on that sheet within 10 feet of the poles? What is the distance from the tree trunk symbols to the nearest poles?

output.reasoning: The agent question progresses from sheet discovery and presence checks (identifying poles and trees) to the actual compliance question: measuring the distance between tree symbols and poles against the 10-foot lateral clearance requirement. The final clause explicitly requests distance measurement, which is the core compliance verification.
